title: ChatTagger
description: A Minecraft plugin by which you can tag a player by just Writing player name in chat and player got a Msg that Player mentioned you in chat by which you friend never ignores you
body:
## ChatTagger
**A Minecraft mod by which you can tag player in chat**                         
by Playername - tag a Perticular player                                                                         
or @everyone - Tag Everyone in the server                                                                 
**Example** Notch or @everyone                                                                  
_A Minecraft Plugin With Premium Features With Fully Customizable Config.yml_                            
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![A Player Mentioned me](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f814bd041675fe72dfa13ab5b37418a1d5992b8_0.webp) 

</details>


                                                                                                 
**As you can see a player Mentioned Me** 
                                                                                                                                                                 

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![A Player Mentioned Everyone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3484c5921150616952251b29c761a775cae7033_0.webp)

</details>


                                                                                                            
**As You can see a player Mentioned Everyone**                                                        
                                                                                                         
## Commands-:
                                                                                                        

```
/ct mute <playername>
```
 - **A Admin Commands For Toggle Mute of a Spefic Player ( Player can not tag Anyone Anymore )**                                                     
                                                                                                    

```
/ct reload
```
 - **A Admin Commands to relod ConfigFile of the plugin**                                                    
                                                                                                   

```
/ct toggle
```
 - **A player command to Enable/Desable Toggle Tag from player side**
